clusters.name: your sister Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within the year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, distance between your parents by November as your father worked late most nights, you with stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah in shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September 1996; her functioning fell and stayed down through these months, and the shifts in the household moved from one person to the next.
